_comment: Generated by pterodactyl/build-mongodb-egg.mjs. Import into the panel: Nests > (a nest) > Import Egg.
name: MongoDB 8
author: ethsmith@users.noreply.github.com
description: MongoDB 8 for the Fragg 3.0 API. mongod runs in the foreground with authentication always on, data in /home/container/db. Install creates an admin user (root) and an app user (readWrite on one database); reinstalling keeps the data and resets both users to the passwords set here.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: MongoDB user with the root role, for administration (mongosh, mongodump, mongorestore).

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the admin user, 12 or more characters. Changing it takes effect on Reinstall (data is kept).

variables.name: App Username
variables.description: MongoDB user the API connects as. It can only read and write the App Database.

variables.name: App Password
variables.description: Password for the app user, 12 or more characters. Changing it takes effect on Reinstall (data is kept).

variables.name: App Database
variables.description: Database the app user may read and write. Use the same name in the API's MONGODB_URI.

variables.name: WiredTiger Cache (GB)
variables.description: MongoDB's in-memory cache. Keep it at or below half the server's memory limit, or the container can be killed for running out of memory.
